definitions.gloss: influential person; person of power; notable figure
definitions.explanation: A person who holds significant influence, power, or authority in a community, organization, or field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I consulted a local person of influence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Influential figures in politics gathered together.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧。
examples.english: The project succeeded with the support of influential people in the region.

notes:
Built from ⟦{有力|ゆうりょく}→有力：13007_yuuryoku⟧ (influential, powerful) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Refers to someone who holds significant sway in a community, organization, or political sphere.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}: local person of influence
- ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}: political heavyweight
- ⟦{財界|ざいかい}→財界：22340_zaikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}: influential figure in the business world

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}→実力者：21845_jitsuryokusha⟧: person of real power (emphasizes actual ability)
- ⟦{権力者|けんりょくしゃ}→権力者：17021_kenryokusha⟧: person in authority (emphasizes formal power)
- ⟦{名士|めいし}→名士：21860_meishi⟧: notable figure, distinguished person (emphasizes reputation)

REGISTER:
A formal word. More common in news, political discussion, and written Japanese than in casual conversation.
